column1: # Golden corpus: US English (en-US). One word per line: word<TAB>division<TAB>note.
# Division: "-" marks every acceptable break, "=" marks a main joint (compound boundary).
# Basis: Merriam-Webster divisions as followed by the Chicago Manual of Style §7.36-47 (pronunciation first).
# Acceptable = allowed by that practice AND not misleading (no the-rapist, mans-laughter, leg-end).
# The test applies the length rules (2 letters before, 3 after).
# Written from knowledge of the practice, not copied from a dictionary: see docs/progress.md for the review status.
